opacity.$description: #FFFFFF20: a card in the hero (contact card of a person, a place) is a veil of the hero text colour, a little denser than the design system's --theme-card-opacity (components/hero-theme.css).

height.$description: The hero grows with its content from its min-height, where the design system fixes its height.

brightness.$description: A cover image is darkened to 30%, where the design system stops at 50%: the white text over it stays readable on any photograph.

default.$description: $hero-min-height-mobile 400px, header included: the hero slides under the header, see theme/components/hero.css.

fontSize.$description: $home-hero-h1-font-size 6rem, on the RFS curve of the headings.

paddingBlockEnd.$description: $global-spacing 5rem under the content, RFS like the SASS theme's padding-bottom. Flat rather than under padding.block, which @uncinq/component-tokens already defines as a token.
